en: A monochrome postcard view of a town square with historic buildings. On the left stands a tall tower with a spire and a clock on its façade, attached to lower residential and commercial houses. Along the ground floors, signs advertise shops and a hotel-restaurant. On the right is a large stepped‑gabled building with the sign "Ratskeller," suggesting a town hall complex. The square in front is mostly empty, with a few small figures of people. At the top in red print is the caption indicating the town and the market square.
